latest_release.name: v3.1.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: 修复运行docker-compose-all.yaml报错的问题 by @MrWws in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/283
* fate：增加自定义模型，调整前端模型选择下拉框 by @xiaonie7 in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/291
* 添加智谱向量模型实现 by @yangzhen233 in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/290
* Feature/rerank model by @yangzhen233 in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/292
* 升级RAG模块 by @RobustH in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/293
* Refresh MiniMax models and protocol support by @octo-patch in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/313
* fix: 修复 odrant初始化创建集合问题 by @Jackjiayou in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/298
* fix: 修复本地启动、数据库初始化与构建问题 by @MuSan-Li in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/314
* 修复RAG相关逻辑优化 by @MuSan-Li in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/315
* feat: 注册默认角色绑定 + 短剧流式超时兜底 + trace 测试适配 by @ageerle in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/318

## New Contributors
* @MrWws made their first contribution in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/283
* @yangzhen233 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/290
* @octo-patch made their first contribution in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/313
* @Jackjiayou made their first contribution in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/298
* @ageerle made their first contribution in https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/pull/318

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ageerle/ruoyi-ai/compare/v3.0.0...v3.1.0
